Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: standalone transparent photographic asset, concept C "Architecture of the plan", for a refined real-estate mortgage calculator website card. NOT a website mockup, not a text banner.
Primary request: create an exceptionally high-quality architectural advertising photomontage of a detailed apartment model cutaway. The scene should feel like an expensive professional architectural presentation photographed for a real-estate campaign, not a toy or game.
Composition: very wide and low landscape scene, target aspect ratio 1.85:1, all objects fully within the frame with transparent margins. The cutaway apartment is the middle and rear layer, spreading horizontally. A small real ivory physical calculator and a pair of silver house keys overlap the model's front edge in the foreground. The apartment and the two real objects must read immediately, while the room details reward a closer look.
Architecture: a refined sectional architectural scale model of a contemporary, believable one-bedroom apartment, with the roof and front walls removed to reveal an inviting living room and adjacent kitchen. Warm oak plank floor with visible grain and staggered joints, softly textured pale plaster walls with realistically thick sectional edges, tall side glazing with restrained metallic frames, warm natural stone kitchen counter and island, clean lower kitchen cabinets, a cream linen sofa with natural cushion seams and a muted sky-blue throw, a low dark-wood coffee table with a small ceramic bowl, a sculptural floor lamp and one small leafy indoor plant. Realistic construction logic and sensible floor plan; no unrealistic miniature dollhouse clutter. Use furniture, proportion and light that suggest grown-up architectural photography. The model's thin ivory plinth follows the apartment outline.
Foreground: unbranded ivory calculator with graphite keys and one subtle cyan accent key, tilted slightly so its face is readable, display a single zero. Two physically believable silver house keys on a plain ring lie to its right. A corner of a rolled or folded floor-plan drawing, with only fine abstract architectural lines and no readable labels, sits subtly below the model on the left. Objects and model share one implied plane and unified perspective.
Brand motif: behind the architectural model, two large restrained parallelogram / diamond planes inspired by a geometric real-estate logo. One is luminous but not glowing sky-cyan tinted glass with a clean fine edge; the other is matte graphite, offset behind it. They frame the model and echo architectural geometry, never forming a readable logo. Keep them as quiet compositional accents.
Lighting: unified soft daylight from upper left, subtle ambient shadows in room corners, credible window light on oak floor, gentle highlights on metal and glass. Warm, calm, highly detailed editorial realism.
Materials: tactile linen weave, pale natural stone pores, wood grain, brushed metal, paper thickness, finely detailed sofa stitching. Sharp credible craftsmanship across the model; no generic smooth CGI.
Background: genuine transparent alpha surrounding the entire isolated composition. Preserve clean cutout edges and subtle contact shadows fading fully to transparency. NO opaque backdrop, NO hazy vignette, NO rectangular floor or studio background, NO checkerboard pattern. The final asset will sit on a pale sage #EDF0E9 web surface.
Color palette: ivory, natural light oak, warm stone, graphite #252C2F, restrained sky cyan #57C4ED, quiet natural greenery.
Text: none. No headings, labels, words, logos, watermarks, rates or percentages. Only ordinary calculator key digits and arithmetic symbols are permitted.
Avoid: no people, no money, no coins, no toy-like plastic, no cartoon, no game rendering, no extreme isometric projection, no oversized furniture, no impossible rooms, no enormous calculator, no floating disconnected objects, no cropped objects, no text.
